atoms.text: Next, Edgar wants to show you some mountains.

instruction.text: Select the top of this mountain to learn more.

feedback.end: The top of a mountain is called the summit. Ben Nevis in Scotland has the highest summit in the UK.

instruction.text: Now we are in the Himalayas. Select the tallest summit to find out more.

feedback.end: The Himalayas are a mountain range in Asia. This is Mount Everest - the highest mountain in the world. It is 8,848m tall!

instruction.text: Edgar would like to climb Ben Nevis to make some observations. Answer Edgar’s questions.

atoms.a: “In which month would it be safer to climb Ben Nevis?”
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m10'>In which month would it be safer to climb Ben Nevis?</voice>

feedback.correct: Exactly! In June, it is drier and warmer. The days are also longer, so you would have more time to get up and back down again.

atoms.a: “What could we use to measure the temperature at the summit?”
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m10'>What could we use to measure the temperature at the summit?</voice>

feedback.correct: Did you know that the higher you are, the lower the temperature will be? It is usually 10°C colder at the summit of Ben Nevis than at the bottom.

atoms.a: “What else should we pack to climb Ben Nevis?”
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m10'>What should we pack to climb Ben Nevis</voice>

feedback.correct: It is important to stay hydrated - especially when climbing a mountain!
feedback.wrong: A tea set would not be very useful on a mountain!

atoms.a: “What should we wear to climb Ben Nevis?”
atoms.sound: ssml: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m10'>What should we wear to climb Ben Nevis</voice>

feedback.correct: Good idea! It can get very cold at the summit, even during the summer.
feedback.wrong: It wouldn’t be a very good idea to climb a mountain in flip flops!

instruction.text: This is Mont Blanc. Select the snow to learn more.

text: Mont Blanc is the highest mountain in Western Europe at 4,809m. The snow going to the summit is a glacier. Glaciers are permanent bodies of ice that can be found on our highest mountains.

atoms.a: Mount Everest is the tallest mountain in the world.
The bottom of a mountain is called the summit.
It is easier and safer to climb Ben Nevis during the summer.
A glacier is all the rock near the summit of a mountain.
